create_tokenizer_openai_gpt: create an OpenAIGPTTokenizer instance with vocab and merges files for BPE tokenization
run_bpe_tokenization: run BPE tokenization on a text string using the OpenAIGPTTokenizer bpe method
convert_token_to_id: convert a token string to its corresponding vocabulary id using _convert_token_to_id
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a sequence of BPE tokens back into a single readable string
save_tokenizer_vocabulary: save the tokenizer vocabulary and merge files to a specified directory
